sources.title: VELCADE (bortezomib) for injection prescribing information, section 12.3, read via MedLibrary reproduction
Bortezomib for injection (Pfizer) prescribing information, section 12.3

agreement_between_sources: Both copies give the same values for every item below.

cmax_first_dose_1_3_ng_ml.quote: after the first dose (Day 1) were 57 and 112 ng/mL

cmax_subsequent_doses_1_3_ng_ml.quote: 89 to 120 ng/mL for the 1.3 mg/m2 dose

clearance_first_dose_l_h.quote: The mean total body clearances were 102 and 112 L/h following the first dose

clearance_subsequent_doses_l_h.quote: ranged from 15 to 32 L/h following subsequent doses

terminal_half_life_multiple_dosing_1_3_h.quote: 76 to 108 hours after the 1.3 mg/m2 dose

not_stated: Time from injection to the Cmax sample.
Whether clearance values are per patient or per m2 (read as per patient).
use: Reference ranges for checking the Lignet adult PK model; no acceptance limits are implied.
